capabilities: Browse a chosen list property's values as clickable tags with note counts
Include child tags when filtering, e.g. work matches work/review
Narrow the tag list with a find field
Copy a generated Bases filter expression for the selected tag
Combine multiple properties and core tags in one view (Pro)
disambiguation: Read-only: it browses property values as tags but cannot rename tags or edit note properties.
extras: Freemium: free tier covers one list property; Pro (multiple properties, combined core-tag view) costs $15 one time or $5 per month via GitHub Sponsors, with sign-in checks that can work offline up to 14 days. Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and after updates it opens a 'What's new' tab suggesting other NoteMods plugins.
problem: Obsidian's tag pane only covers the built-in tags property, so values stored in other list properties cannot be browsed or clicked as tags.
summary: Tag browser that shows a custom list property's values as clickable tags in a dedicated view, with note counts, child tags and Bases filters.
